# PyPI · The Python Package Index

> PyPI is the official Python package repository, hosting millions of open-source packages and enabling secure distribution and installation of Python software.

PyPI (Python Package Index) serves as the central hub for Python package discovery, distribution, and management. Maintained by the Python Software Foundation and supported by the Python Packaging Authority (pypa), PyPI provides essential infrastructure for the Python ecosystem including package publishing, installation via pip, security features like Trusted Publishers and two-factor authentication, and comprehensive documentation for developers.

## Getting Started & Core Resources

- [PyPI Homepage](https://pypi.org): PyPI homepage - the official Python package repository and distribution platform
- [PyPI Documentation](https://docs.pypi.org): Official PyPI documentation including guides, getting started, and contributing
- [Help Center](https://pypi.org/help): PyPI help center covering account management, authentication, and publishing

## Security & Account Management

- [Security Policy](https://pypi.org/security): PyPI security policy and vulnerability disclosure procedures

## News & Community

- [PyPI Blog](https://blog.pypi.org): Official PyPI blog covering security, updates, and package management news
- [Sponsors](https://pypi.org/sponsors): PyPI sponsors and funding information from PSF and open source organizations
